posts.title: A small homelab that fixes itself (mostly)
posts.description: I have a little mini PC living in my office. It’s a humble box with an Intel N100 and 16 GB of RAM, running Ubuntu Server. I bought it years ago, so I don’t want to know how much it sells for today. posts.title: How room repaints work on Swatcher
posts.description: The room visualiser I built earlier uses stock rooms rendered in Blender and recolours them in the browser with plain colour maths. I’d ruled out generative models for it: they guess, and a paint tool that guesses is a bad paint tool. But I think people kept want their room, not mine. posts.title: Swatcher: Change a Palette in Your Own Words
posts.description: Until now, a palette on Swatcher was a one-shot thing. You described a room, got back a set of real paints, and if one of them wasn’t quite right, your options were to start again or swap colours in by hand. Now you can just say what you’d like changed.
